profile.name: Raf
profile.intro: Full-stack developer working across the stack — from database schema and APIs to the last pixel of the UI. I like boring infrastructure, clear code, and products that just work.
profile.photoAlt: Portrait of Rafael Vincent D. Medina

paragraphs: I'm a software developer who enjoys turning messy requirements into simple, well-structured systems. Most of my work lives on the web: React and Next.js on the front, Node, Python and Postgres behind it.
I care about the things that keep a codebase healthy over time — sensible abstractions, good tests, readable pull requests, and shipping in small, safe steps.

projects.title: DTR for Internship
projects.description: DTR System is a web-based Daily Time Record application built for interns to track their daily attendance and rendered hours. Users can register, log in, and record their AM/PM time-in and time-out, including half-day entries. The system automatically computes hours worked and undertime, shows a dashboard with weekly and total hours, and keeps a monthly attendance history with remarks. Users can download their monthly DTR as a printable PDF and reset forgotten passwords by email.

experience.text: Shipped features end-to-end across a React frontend and Node/Postgres backend. Introduced CI checks and automated tests.
Building and maintaining customer-facing web apps and internal tools. Led a migration to Next.js that cut page load times by ~40%.
Fixed bugs, wrote my first production code, and learned how real teams ship software.
